tasks.subject: Task 1: The slab arena in wok_rc.{c,h}
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the allocator internals with the slab arena (malloc retained behind WOK_RC_MALLOC, poison behind WOK_RC_POISON, additive stat readers), proven by an extended standalone C test and the full Haskell differential oracle.

**Files:** Modify runtime/wok_rc.h (3 additive stat decls), runtime/wok_rc.c (replace allocator internals), runtime/test/wok_rc_test.c (arena assertions).

**Acceptance Criteria:** -Werror-clean under cabal cc-options; standalone test asserts reuse/slab-boundary/large/teardown; full Haskell suite green with live==baseline; dup/dec/slot/tag/arity + 4 original stats unchanged.

**Verify:** bash scripts/asan-runtime.sh && cabal test 2>&1 | tail -8

```json:metadata
{"files": ["runtime/wok_rc.h", "runtime/wok_rc.c", "runtime/test/wok_rc_test.c"], "verifyCommand": "bash scripts/asan-runtime.sh && cabal test 2>&1 | tail -8", "acceptanceCriteria": ["wok_rc.c -Werror-clean", "standalone test asserts reuse/slab-boundary/large/teardown", "full Haskell suite green, live==baseline", "dup/dec/slot/tag/arity + 4 stats unchanged"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Sanitizer matrix + UAF oracle + microbench
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Run the standalone test under ASan/UBSan(+LSan) across arena, WOK_RC_MALLOC, and WOK_RC_POISON variants; add an alloc/free microbench comparing arena vs malloc.

**Files:** Create runtime/test/wok_rc_bench.c; modify scripts/asan-runtime.sh.

**Acceptance Criteria:** asan-runtime.sh builds+runs 3 variants, each OK + sanitizer-clean, exit 0; LSan only where supported (Darwin guard); microbench prints ns/op for arena and malloc.

**Verify:** bash scripts/asan-runtime.sh && bash scripts/asan-runtime.sh bench

```json:metadata
{"files": ["runtime/test/wok_rc_bench.c", "scripts/asan-runtime.sh"], "verifyCommand": "bash scripts/asan-runtime.sh && bash scripts/asan-runtime.sh bench", "acceptanceCriteria": ["3 variants OK + sanitizer-clean, exit 0", "LSan only where supported", "microbench prints ns/op arena vs malloc"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Docs + memory
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Record the arena as the live allocator (ABI unchanged), mark the deferred slice done, update the memory note.

**Files:** Modify runtime/README.md, both specs (arena -> IMPLEMENTED, slice-1 §9 marked done), memory note + MEMORY.md.

**Acceptance Criteria:** README allocator bullet describes the slab arena (ABI unchanged, malloc behind WOK_RC_MALLOC); arena spec status IMPLEMENTED; slice-1 §9 bullet marked implemented; memory note + MEMORY.md updated with absolute dates.

**Verify:** grep -n 'slab arena' runtime/README.md && grep -n IMPLEMENTED docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-21-c-runtime-arena-allocator-design.md

{"files": ["runtime/README.md", "docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-21-c-runtime-arena-allocator-design.md", "docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-21-c-runtime-allocator-ncon-design.md"], "verifyCommand": "grep -n 'slab arena' runtime/README.md && grep -n IMPLEMENTED docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-21-c-runtime-arena-allocator-design.md", "acceptanceCriteria": ["README allocator bullet = slab arena, ABI unchanged", "arena spec IMPLEMENTED", "slice-1 §9 marked implemented", "memory note + MEMORY.md updated"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
